Aaron Hickey.note: Hickey stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Aaron Hickey.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Andy Robertson.note: Robertson's edge is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Andy Robertson.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在危险出现前组织好队友。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Angus Gunn.summary: Angus Gunn is a Scotland goalkeeper who most recently played for Nottingham Forest and has been Scotland's first-choice keeper during the 2026 World Cup.
Angus Gunn.note: Gunn stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Angus Gunn.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Anthony Ralston.note: Ralston's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Anthony Ralston.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Ben Gannon-Doak.note: Gannon-Doak stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Ben Gannon-Doak.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。

Che Adams.note: Adams's edge is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Che Adams.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Craig Gordon.note: Watch Gordon for staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Craig Gordon.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Dominic Hyam.note: Hyam stands out for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Dominic Hyam.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Findlay Curtis.note: Curtis is defined by pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Findlay Curtis.noteZh: 他靠带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

George Hirst.note: Hirst is defined by making purposeful movement away from the ball. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
George Hirst.noteZh: 他靠用有目的的无球移动创造接应点与同位置球员拉开差异。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Grant Hanley.note: Watch Hanley for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Grant Hanley.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Jack Hendry.note: Hendry is defined by recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Jack Hendry.noteZh: 他靠第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

John McGinn.note: McGinn stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
John McGinn.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

John Souttar.note: Souttar's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
John Souttar.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Kenny McLean.note: McLean is defined by keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Kenny McLean.noteZh: 他靠压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定与同位置球员拉开差异。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Kieran Tierney.note: Tierney stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Kieran Tierney.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Lawrence Shankland.note: Shankland stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn.
Lawrence Shankland.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。

Lewis Ferguson.note: Ferguson is defined by reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Lewis Ferguson.noteZh: 他靠在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段与同位置球员拉开差异。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Liam Kelly.note: Kelly stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He waits for the strike before committing. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Liam Kelly.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Lyndon Dykes.note: Watch Dykes for giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Lyndon Dykes.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Nathan Patterson.note: Patterson's signature is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Nathan Patterson.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在防线暴露后的回追速度上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ross Stewart.note: Watch Stewart for giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Ross Stewart.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Ryan Christie.note: Christie's edge is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Ryan Christie.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Scott McKenna.note: McKenna's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Scott McKenna.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Scott McTominay.note: Watch McTominay for creating a better angle for the next pass. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Scott McTominay.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Tyler Fletcher.note: Fletcher's edge is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Tyler Fletcher.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。
